title: Faster Whisper (Craig)
description: Transcribe multi-track audio with Faster Whisper. Tracks are decoded together in GPU batches, with word timestamps and optional punctuation correction across tracks.

input.name: Preload model
input.description: Model loaded when the worker starts, so the first job doesn't wait for it. Jobs that request another model replace it.

input.name: Batch size
input.description: Speech chunks decoded together per GPU batch. Lower this if the GPU runs out of memory.

input.name: Preparation threads
input.description: CPU workers for audio decoding and voice activity detection. Leave empty to use the container's CPU quota.

input.name: Max concurrency
input.description: Tracks transcribed at once on the sequential path (batched: false, or translate). 0 means no limit.

input.name: Punctuation chunk size
input.description: Words sent to the punctuation model at a time when transcription_corrector is enabled.
